tei:div.tei:p: "$ (311)༄༅// slob dpon dga' rab rdo rje nas brgyud pa'i rdzogs pa chen po sems sde'i pra khrid kyi

man ngag bzhugs so/// / rdzogs pa chen po sems sde khams lugs/ (312)༄༅// oṃ swa sti/ rang bzhin skye med chos kyi sku// rol pa 'gag med sprul pa'i sku// mtshan nyid dbyer med longs spyod sku// rig pa rang grol ngo bo'i sku// 'pho 'gyur med pa rdo rje'i sku// sku lnga yongs rdzogs kun tu bzang*// bka' brgyud bla mar bcas pa la// dbyer med rang snang 'dud phyag 'tshal// de la 'dir theg pa dgu'i yang rtse/ rgyud sde bzhi'i snying po/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad bgrod pa gcig tu gyur pa'i lam/ rnal 'byor pa thams cad kyi don du gnyer bya'i man ngag /sprul pa'i sku mchog dga' rab rdo rjes mdzad pa'i rdzogs pa chen po'i pra khrid kyi man ngag 'di la gnyis te/ bla ma brgyud tshul gyi rim pa dang*/ man ngag dngos so// dang po la ring brgyud ni/ chos sku kun tu bzang po/ longs sku rdo rje sems dpal/ sprul sku dga' rab rdo rje/ rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa'o// de nas slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ dha he na ta lo/ ind+ra bhū ti/ go ma de ba/ rab snang brtan ma/ tshogs kyi bdag po/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ rdo rje legs pa rtsal/ ku ku rā dza/ thor tshugs (313)dgu pa/ mar me mdzad/ shrī siṃ dha/ bai ro tsa na'i bar/ rig 'dzin rig par brgyud pa'o// de nas g.yu sgra snying po/ gsal rab chen po/ rma dpal gyi rgyal po/ gnyan byang chub shes rab/ yon tan 'byung gnas/ cog ro sgom chung*/ byams pa sgom chen/ byang ston rnam dag /dam pa bde gshegs/ chos rje gtsang pa/ byams pa chen po/ spyan snga ba/ g.yan pa rin po che/ bo dhi shrī/ chos rje badzra shrī'i bar gang zag snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa'o// yang byams pa chen pos nas/ tsa sde spyan snga ba/ drung thugs rje ye shes/ ston pa dbang 'byor dpal/ des badzra shrī ste/ g.yan pa dang*/ byang chub dpal/ ston pa ba gsum kas/ dpal 'bar ba la gang byo'i tshul du tshig don ma lus pa gnang ba'o// nye brgyud ni/

dam pa chen po la dpal rdo rje sems dpas dngos su zhal gzigs nas yang dag pa'i don ma lus pa gnang ba'o// shin tu nye brgyud ni/ rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid sangs rgyas dngos yin par rgyud thams cad nas gsungs so// brgyud pa'i bar ma chad pa ni rang gi sems nyid rtogs na sku lnga (314)lhun grub sangs rgyas kyi yin par gsungs so// gnyis pa brgyud pa de las byung ba'i man ngag la gsum ste/ sngon tu 'gro bas rgyud snod du rung bar byed pa dang*/ dngos gzhi nyams su blang ba'i rim pa dang*/ rjes 'bras bu ci ltar thob pa'i tshul bstan pa'o// dang po la gsum gyi thog mar yi ge brgya ba'i bsgom bzlas dang*/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor thun mong du bya ba ni/ bdag dang sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las sgrol nas sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob pa zhig dkon mchog drug po 'di mkhyen snyam pa byas la/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su 'gro ba mang du bya'o// de nas khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyis/ thog ma med pa nas bdag gi pha ma byas shing drin gyis bskyangs pa kho na yin pa rnams da lta rigs drug 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal myong ba 'di dag bde ba dang ldan sdug bsngal dang bral nas sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god par byed pa la/ thog mar bdag 'tshang rgya dgos te/ de'i ched du dge sbyor bya'o snyam du nges par sems bskyed/ de nas rin po che'i sa gzhi sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams rnam par dag pa'i dbus su padma nyi zla'i steng du/ rang gi sems nyid hūm̐ dkar po las 'od 'phros 'phags pa mchod sems can gyi don byas sgrib pa sbyangs nas rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang la bkod/ 'od tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol ba/

zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung dang dar sna lnga'i shams thabs byas pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ la yi ge brgya pas g.yas su 'khor ba/ rang gi spyi gtsug (315)nyi zla'i steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog sngon po nam mkha'i mdog can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu bsnol mar 'dzin cing dar dang rin po che dang rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ snang la rang bzhin med pa 'ja' tshon gyi sku lta bu'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam par byon nas spyi bo'i bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' la thim pa lan bdun/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya g.yas su bskor ba dang*/ se gol bcas pas lan bdun yi ge brgya pa tshar bdun bzla ba rim bzhin sprod/ de nas bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gsung thugs las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun byung nas rang gi spyi bor babs/ lus kyi nad gdon sems kyi sdig sgrib dam tshig chags nyams thams cad 'og sgo dang*/ rkang zhabs su bud nas song bas/ rang lus phru ma phus btab pa lta bu'i nang zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i gang bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ badzra sa twa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badzra sa twa twe no pa tiṣṭha/ dṛ ḍho me bha ba/ su to ṣyo me bha wa/ a nu rakto me bha ba/ su po ṣyo me bha ba/ sarba siddhi mme pra ya tstsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsittaṃ shrī yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān sarba ta thā ga ta// badzra mā me muñtsa badzrī bha ba ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥ zhes gsal dag tu bzlas shing*/ thun rting la bdag gi sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad bshags so/ dag par mdzad du gsol/

zhes brjod la bla ma rang la bstim/ rang thugs ka'i rdo rje la/ de hūm̐ la/ hūm̐ 'ja' yal ba ltar song nas chos kyi dbyings su 'dres par bsam pa'i ngang nas (316)dmigs med du bzhag la bsngo smon bya'o// de nas rtags thon par byed pa gal che ste/ rtags ni sngar bas dad pa che ba/ mi rtag pa rgyud la skye ba/ sems dga' zhing dge sbyor la blo 'jug pa/ sems can la byams snying rje skye ba dang rmi lam du ri dang skas la sogs par gyen la 'gro ba/ nam langs pa/ nyi zla shar ba/ khrus byed pa/ dar phyar ba/ dud 'bud pa/ lha cha dkrol ba/ lus las 'bu srin dang khrag rnag bud pa/ skyugs sbyong dang gos dkar po gyon pa/ me tog gi gling du phyin pa la sogs pa rmi'o// dgongs pa tshig gsum par/ rdo rje sems dpa' bsgoms nas ni// sngags kyang rab tu zlo byed pa// de yi sdig kun dag nas kyang*// rdo rje sems dpa' 'dra bar 'gyur// ces dang*/ sgom pa las/ mdun du thugs kyi ngo bo rdo rje sems dpa' ni/ nam mkha'i mdog can rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa'i gnas gsum du// sku gsung thugs kyi yig 'bru 'od zer can// bdag gi lus la zhugs pas sdig pa dag nas byin rlabs 'jug pa nyid// ces gsungs so// gnyis pa tshogs gnyis rdzogs shing byin rlabs 'jug par byed pa maṇḍal dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang*/ yi ge brgya pa'i bsgom bzlas sngon du song bas/ rang yi dam rdo rje sems dpa'i smin mtshams nas bhrūṃ spros pa las mdun gyi maṇḍal de 'od du zhu bas rin po che kha dog brgya rtsa brgyad la mig mang ris su bsdebs pa'i sa gzhi mnan na nem pa bteg na 'phar ba/ gzhi mdo thams cad rin po che sna tshogs pa'i tshom bus spras pa/ mig gis bltar mi bzod pa'i 'od dang ldan pa rgya chos dbyings nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i dbus su/ rin po che'i khri ka ba brgyad kyis (317)btegs pa mdzod mig bdun bdun dang ldan pa/

gdung ma zung sgril du 'khor ba seng ge brgyad kyis btegs cing rin po che'i drwa bas khri khebs byas pa'i steng du/ padma stong ldan dang nyi ma'i gdan la/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dang chos sku kun tu bzang po dbyer med pa la/ brgyud tshul gsum gyi bla ma rnams kyis bskor ba/ de'i mdun du glang chen brgyad kyis btegs pa'i gdan drug brtsegs la/ yi dam rgyal ba'i lha tshogs la mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams kyis bskor ba/ bla ma'i g.yas su rta mchog brgyad kyis btegs pa'i gdan drug brtsegs la/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog sku gsum gyis bsdus pa rnams dang*/ rgyab phyogs su rma bya brgyad kyis btegs pa'i gdan drug brtsegs la/ chos dkon mchog rgyu 'bras lam gsum gyis bsdus pa rnams gser gyi shog bu la bai ḍūrya zhun mas rang nan du bris pa'i glegs bam rang sgra grags pa rnams dang*/ g.yon phyogs su shang shang brgyad kyis btegs pa'i gdan la/ dge 'dun dkon mchog rig pa 'dzin pa rnams la sa dang lam la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang rang sangs rgyas nyan thos chen po dgra bcom pa rnams bzhugs par bsams la/ rang bzhin gyi gnas dang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten nas/ de 'dra ba thams cad spyan drangs la so sor bstim/ de dag la mchod pa'i dngos po nam mkha' khyab tshad kyi 'jig rten gyi khams sa gzhi dang ri dang khang pa thams cad kyang rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa// rtsi shing nags tshal thams cad dpag bsam shing las dgos 'dod 'byung ba/ mtsho dang chu thams cad yan lag brgyad ldan gyi mtsho dang rdzing bu gser dngul gyi bye ma gdal ba/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya thams cad mchod rdzas kyi bye brag dngos po bzang la gya nom pa/ rang (318)gi lus zhing gi rdul snyed du sprul nas/ skye 'gro lha'i bu dang bu mo/ gzugs byad mchog tu gyur pa/ ngag tu ci smra thams cad dbyangs dang bstod pa/

rkang lag gi 'du byed thams cad bro dang gar/ lus kyi rgyan dang gos/ lag tu gang bzung thams cad lha'i na bza' do shal dpung rgyan se mo do dang*/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas su gyur pa dang*/ nam mkha' bar snang sa gzhi thams cad rin po che'i sprin las dgos 'dod char du dbab pa dang*/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan bla re yol ba la sogs pa sprin bzhin 'khrigs pa/ me tog utpa la dang padma la sogs dri bsung phyogs bcur 'phro ba rnams rtsi shing ltar rgyas pa/ mdor na phyogs bcu rab 'byams mu med mtha' klas pa thams cad/ 'phags pa kun du bzang po'i rnam par thar pa lta bu'i mchod pas rgyas par bkang ste 'bul bar bsams la/ mchod pa'i phyag rgya chen po ni// sems kyi yid bzhin sprin tshogs kyis// phyogs bcu thams cad sangs rgyas zhing*// mnyen 'jam reg na bde ba yi// sna tshogs rin po che yi gzhir// mdzes par bres shing spras pa dang*// kun 'byung rin chen phung po 'bar// dbyings legs rdzing bu bro mchog bsel// rin chen khang pa sna tshogs dang*// rgyan dang dpag bsam ljon pa'i tshal// glu dbyangs tshigs su bcad pa'i sgra// bla bre rgyal mtshan na bza' gdugs// do shal dpung rgyan se mo do// bza' dang btung ba'i mchog rnams kyis// rang la mdzes par brgyan pa yi// lha dang lha mo rdul snyed kyi// bro gar la sogs bsam yas kyis// phyogs bcu nam mkha'i khams bkang nas// dkyil 'khor kun la rgyas par 'bul// ces dmigs pa dang bcas pas brgya rtsa'am nyer gcig la sogs thun re la bya'o// de ltar (319)sems nyid skye ba med pa'i ngang las 'gag pa med pa'i rtsal gyi rnam pa 'phrul ba sgyu 'phrul chen po'i tshul du mchod pa ni/ longs sku'i zhing sgrub pa'i maṇḍal thun mong ma yin pa'o// de nas sprul sku'i zhing sgrub pa thun mong gi maṇḍal 'bul ba ni/ rang yi dam rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs ka nas trām̐ cig spros pa 'od du zhu ba las/

mtha' yi rgya mtsho chen po'i dbus su ri bo mchog rab/ shar shel dkar po las grub pa/ lho bai ḍūrya sngon po/ nub padma rā ga dmar po/ byang gser las grub pa ser po/ steng sum cu rtsa gsum lha'i longs spyod/ phyi rol rgyal chen sde bzhi'i longs spyod/ khong gseng lha ma yin gyi longs spyod/ 'og klu'i longs spyod dang bcas pa gser gyi ri bdun rol pa'i mtsho bdun gyis bskor ba/ de'i shar phyogs kyi gling lus 'phags po dang*/ g.yas g.yon du gling g.yogs lus dang lus 'phags gnyis/ de bzhin du lho 'dzam bu gling*/ rnga yab dang rnga yab gzhan/ nub ba glang spyod/ g.yo ldan dang lam mchog 'gro/ byang sgra mi snyan/ sgra mi snyan dang sgra mi snyan gyi zla/ gling gi phyi rol lcags ri mu khyud kyis bskor ba/ gling rnams su 'khor lo/ nor bu/ btsun mo/ blon po/ glang po/ rta mchog /dmag dpon te rgyal srid sna bdun dang*/ gter chen po'i bum pa/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad la sogs pa lha mi'i longs spyod dpal 'byor gyis gang ba dang*/ nam mkhas khyab tshad kyi gling bzhi 'jig rten/ stong gsum mu med pa thams cad/ rin chen sman dang 'bru la sogs pas bkang ste/ sngar gyi dmigs yul tshan pa lnga po la 'bul bar bsams la/ trām̐/ gling bzhi dkyil 'khor rin chen ldan// dpag bsam shing dang (320)rdzing bu mdzes// las bzhi byin rlabs lhun grub pa// lha dang lha mo'i longs spyod ldan// lhag pa ting 'dzin mchod par 'bul// ces thun rer brgya'am nyer gcig phul na/ rgyu bsod nams kyi tshogs des 'bras bu ye shes kyi tshogs yongs su rdzogs par byed de/ chos rnams thams cad 'bras bu yongs rdzogs pa'i// sangs rgyas rnams la maṇḍal 'di phul bas// 'bras bu 'phags pa'i nor bdun lhun grub ste// ting 'dzin 'bum phrag rnams la dbang sgyur shog /ces bsngo'o// de nas thal mo sbyar te yid kyis mos gus gdung ba zhe thag pa nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/

na mo/ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ sku dang*/ gsung dang*/ thugs dang*/ yon tan dang*/ phrin las dang*/ zhing khams zag pa med pa zad mi shes pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i bden pa dang*/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho/ gsang ba rgya mtsho/ smin pa rgya mtsho'i bka' brgyud kyi bla ma rin po che rnams kyi byin rlabs kyis/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag ming rdo rje che ge mo zhes bgyi ba la/ rdzogs pa chen po shin tu rnal 'byor gyi don rang byung gi ye shes de kho na nyid kyi gang ba dang*/ shin tu gang ba dang*/ rgyas pa dang*/ shin tu rgyas pa dang*/ smin pa dang*/ shin tu smin pa dang*/ grol ba dang*/ shin tu grol ba rgya chen po mdzad du gsol/ zhes thun re la nyer gcig la sogs pas gsol ba gdab nas/ dkon mchog rigs drug tshan lnga po de 'od du zhu nas rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim/ tshom bu bsdus la rang gi spyi bor bzhag /bla ma bdag la thugs rjes nye bar dgongs nas spyi bor byon te/ sna tshogs padma nyi ma zla ba'i steng du rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba chen po'i sku zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ rdo rje dril bu thugs kar bsnol pas yum (321)la 'khyud pa/ ral pa bcings ba'i lhag ma grol ba/ dar ser po'i tshangs skud se ral khar thogs pa/ yum rdo rje snyem ma dmar mo g.yas yab la 'khyud cing*/ g.yon dril bu snyan rtsar 'khrol ba/ yab yum gnyis ka la rin po che'i dbu rgyan/ rna rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ dpung rgyan/ phyag gdub/ do shal/ se mo do/ sku reg thams cad kyis brgyan cing*/ dar sna lnga'i sham thabs byas pa/ zhabs rdo rje dang padma'i skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ snang la rang bzhin med pa/ nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid dang ldan pa'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po bsam/ de nas bdag gi lus longs spyod kha rje dbang thang dus gsum gyi dge rtsa bde skyid dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa thams cad bla ma dam pa la 'bul lo// bzhes su gsol lo// bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis brlabs du gsol/

lus ngag yid gsum smin cing grol bar byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa bla ma dam pa'i rtogs pa khyad par can da lta nyid du bdag gi rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes gdung sems drag pos brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa gsol ba btab pa'i rjes la/ bla ma yab yum ma chags thabs kyi rol pa'i 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rgyud bskul byin rlabs bsdus bla ma yab yum la thim/ sbyor ba mdzad nas byang sems dkar dmar babs/ bdag gi las nyon shes sgrib thams cad dag nas rang rdo rje sems dpa' nyid du gsal ba la/ bla ma'i dpral bar nas oṃ dkar po 'od zer dang bcas pa byung bdag gi spyi bor thim/ lus kyi sgrib pa dag /sku bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus (322)sprul skur mngon du byas aṃ snyam pa bya'o// de bzhin du bla ma'i mgrin pa nas āḥdamar po 'od zer dang bcas pa byung*/ rang gi lce thog tu thim/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag /gsung gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag longs skur grol/ thugs ka nas hūm̐ mthing ga 'od zer dang bcas pa rang gi snying nang du thim/ yid kyi sgrib pa dag /thugs shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ sems chos skur grol bar bsam/ de nas bla ma yab yum dgyes pa'i tshul gyis tshangs bug nas mar byon/ rang gi snying padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa gzhig tu gyur pa'i dbus su/ nyi zla padma'i gdan la zhal 'dzum mul le/ spyan khra zim me/ thugs dga' yal le/ yab yum dkar dmar lham mer bzhugs pa la ci nus su sems gtad/ de nas bla ma yab yum 'od du zhu nas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i bla ma de'i kā wā tsi dang*/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med du 'dres/ sgo gsum tha dad kyi dri ma dag /ye shes rdo rje'i tshig gis sbyin pa'i dbang thob/ ngo bo nyid dang gsang ba'i sku mngon du gyur aṃ snyam pa'i rjes la/

dus gsum gyi rtog pa bcad nas sems ma bcos lhug par bzhag pa yun bsring*/ thun rting dge ba bsngo ste/ bdag gis dge ba'i las 'di bgyis pa yis// 'jig rten ring por mi thogs sangs rgyas nas// de kun 'gro la phan phyir dam chos kyis// sems can sdug bsngal tsha gdung sgrol gyur cig /'di la rtags ma byung bar du gnyug bsring ba gal che ste/ byin rlabs ma zhugs na nyams rtogs mi skye zhing*/ bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs na nyams rtogs btsan thabs su skye bar gsungs so// rtags ni rab snang srid chos skur rtogs pa/ 'bring snang srid bla mar 'char ba/ bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams gcig (323)car du skye ba/ tha mas 'khor ba la blo ldog cing*/ bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes skye ba dang*/ rmi lam du rin po che dang sangs rgyas kyi zhing la sogs pa dag pa'i snang ba 'byung*/ spyir gsang sngags dbang gis khyad par byas pa yin cing*/ dbang thams cad las ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang zab/ de las bla mal dbang blang pa zab cing*/ bla ma snying dbus su bsgoms pas snying rlung la sogs pa'i smyo 'bogs dang*/ 'byung ba 'khrugs pa'i nad thams cad dang*/ gdon gyi bar chad thams cad mi 'byung zhing*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan rin po che ma lus pa 'byung bar gsungs pa la rang gis myong ba'i nges shes yod pas/ bka' rgya yod kyang gzhan lan gyi blo kho nas bris pa rtsa gsum tshogs la bzod par gsol/ gang gis rdo rje slob dpon nyid// bkur zhing spyi bor sus sgom pa// de la rgyal bas byin gyis rlobs// rgyal ba'i dgongs pa de yis 'dzin// ces pa dang*/ bla ma dam pa he ru ka yi gtsug rgyan nyid// mos shing gus pa yon tan kun gyi gzhi// zhes sogs rgyud sde'i lung dpag tu med do// gsum pa bar chad bsrung ba'i don du rang yi dam he ru ka ye shes kyi khro bo gang rung bsgom pa'i thugs kar hūm̐ mthing nag gcig bsams la/

hūm̐ de 'dra ba grangs med pa byung*/ sna bug g.yas nas phyir thon lo ka'i khams thams cad hūm̐ sgra dang bcas pas gang*/ sna bug g.yon nas tshur byung*/ lus kyi nang thams cad hūm̐ sgra dang bcas pas gang bar bsam zhing*/ ngag tu hūm̐ ring bgang ngo*// dbugs phyir 'gro tshur 'ong gang la yang phyi nang gi hūm̐ gis mgrin pa'i bar du gang bar bsam pa'o// bar chad bsal phyir hūm̐ ring bgrang*// hūm̐ gi sbyor bas phyogs mtshams bsrung*// zhes gsungs so// sngon 'gro 'di rnams dang po re re (324)nas rtags thon par bya zhing*/ phyis kyang thun mgo thams cad la bya'o// thun ring thung gang la yang snga ma bskyur nas phyi ma la 'jug pa ma yin/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nas bzung ste snga ma la phyi ma phyi ma snon pa'i tshul du bya zhing*/ thams cad kyi thun rting dmigs med du bzhag la dge ba bsngo/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis te/ snod bcud kyi mtshan nyid dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rim pa'o// dang po ni/ rtsa tshig las/ nges pa'i lung ldan slob dpon gyis// rnal 'byor pa yi don ched du// byang chub sems kyi pra khrid kyi// sgom pa'i rim pa bstan pa'o// zhes pas/ bla ma dang slob ma gdams ngag gi mtshan nyid gsum ston te/ bla ma ni nges don ston pa'i rgyud lung man ngag mkhyen pa/ kun tu bzang po nas rim par dbang bzhi'i chu bo ma nub pa/ byin rlabs nyams rtogs kyi zam ma chad pa/ snyan brgyud gdams ngag gi gnad ma 'chug pa/ rang 'dod med pa gzhan rjes su bzung nus pa'i bla ma/ slob ma'i mtshan nyid 'khor ba la nges 'byung gi blo skyes pa/ snyan grags la sogs pa tshe 'di'i bya ba rgyab tu dor ba/ dkon mchog gsum la mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang ldan zhing*/ las rgyu 'bras khyad du mi gsod pa/ dbang thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa/ bla ma la sangs rgyas su blta zhing lus longs spyod gtong nus pa/ gdams ngag la gces spras su byed cing phyi bshol med par sgrub pa/

rnal ma don dam pa'i chos nyid la blo 'byor nus pa'i shes rab dang ldan pa'o// gdams ngag gi mtshan nyid ni/ las thabs sna tshogs pas tshe 'di sgrub pa'i thabs dang*/ rang nyid zhi bde sgrub pa theg dman gyi lam dang*/ bskal pa grangs med du sa lam bgrod pa mtshan nyid kyi lugs dang*/ mtshan bcas rtsol sgrub la ltos pa gsang sngags 'og ma'i thabs thams cad las khyad par 'phags pa/ 'khor (325)'das ngo bo gcig pa'i don byang chub kyi sems/ chos sku mngon sum du rtogs shing mngon du byed pa la brda thabs lag len gyi rim pas sra thabs su khrid par byed pa 'di bstan pa'o// gnyis pa ting nge 'dzin gyi rim pa ni/ rtsa tshig las/ dang por gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin// gnyis pa la ni mi g.yo ba// gsum pa mnyam pa nyid du 'gyur// bzhi pa ye shes lhun gyis grub// ces pas/ dper na/ skyes bu rim gyis skyed rdzogs pa la/ byis pa dang*/ gzhon nu dang*/ bar pa dang*/ stobs rdzogs nas tshe dang lus stobs mthar phyin pa bzhi yod cing*/ lo thog rim gyis skyes pa la yang ljang bu dang*/ snye ma dang*/ 'bras bu smin pa dang*/ rnga btsas zin nas mthar phyin pa bzhi yod pa ltar/ gang zag blo'i rim gyis sa lam bgrod pa la yang*/ dang po sems las su rung bar byed pa zhi gnas nyams kyi dus dang*/ gnyis pa lhag mthong rtog pa mi g.yo ba'i dus dang*/ gsum pa zhi gnas nyams rtogs gcig tu 'dres pa mnyam pa nyid kyi dus dang*/ bzhi pa ye shes lhun grub lam mthar phyin pa'i dus kyi rnal 'byor dang bzhi'o// de la dang po sems zhi gnas kyi sems las su rung bar byed pa la bzhi ste/ ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par gzhag pa'i thabs/ de las skyes pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dpe/ de'i drod rtags/ 'bras bu/ ci ltar thob tshul bstan pa'o// dang po bzhag thabs ni/ 'khor ba'i 'du 'dzi spangs nas su// dgon par mnyam par gzhag pa'i tshe// rkyen gyi tshogs rnams ma byung bar// ji srid gnas la gnas zhes bya// zhes pas/

dang por 'jug pa'i 'gal rkyen spang zhing mthun rkyen bstan pa// mnyam par gzhag thabs dngos/ bar du ting nge 'dzin gyi skyon ngos bzung zhing spang ba/ ting nge (326)'dzin gyi ngo bo bzhis ston te/ spang bya ni/ tshe 'dir rang nyid gnyen 'dun dang bcas pa bde skyid dpal 'byor 'dod cing*/ dgra'i phyogs 'dul ba'i don du mi dge ba bcu la sogs sdig pa dang*/ tshong khe spogs so nam rtsol sgrub shes yon gror chog bzo rtsis sman bon la sogs pa'i lto gos dang rnyed bkur snyan grags sgrub pa thams cad 'du 'dzi rnam g.yeng 'khor ba'i bya ba yin pas ring du spangs la/ bsten bya ni/ grong yul las ring du dpag pa dgon pa'i gnas mi dang mi ma yin pa/ gcan gzan la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa med pa chu shing la sogs mthun rkyen bsgrub sla ba/ nyams dga' zhing dge sbyor 'phel ba'i gnas su mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma dang*/ chos mthun gyi grogs bzang po bsten par bya'o// gnyis pa mnyam par gzhag pa'i thabs ni/ gsang sgron las/ ma lus sems can thams cad la// byang chub snying po'i rang bzhin gnas// de don rtogs par bya ba'i phyir// ma zin zin phyir gnad bzhi bsgom// ces pas bca' ba lus kyi gnad bsam gtan chos bdun byas te/ rkang pa skyil krung bca'o// sgal pa drang por bsrang*/ lag pa mnyam gzhag byas nas dpung pa brgyad/ mgrin pa dgug /lce ya rkan la sbyar/ so yar mar ma rig tsam bya/ mchu'i bar rlung 'grim pa tsam du sbyar/ lto ba gsus po che phyir brgyang*/ mig sna rtser smin mtshams nas phar thad kyi lag pa'i sleb so tsam du ma 'gul bar gtad de/ dmigs pa yul gyi gnad ni/ dmigs pa gtad sa de a dkar po gsal zhing 'tsher ba gcig la skad cig kyang ma yengs par gtad do// rgya ba rlung gi gnad ni/ thun mgo la rlung ro drag po lan dgu'am gsum la sogs par 'bud nas dbugs rang sar klod la bzhag

/'dzin (327)pa sems kyi gnad la dmigs bcas dang dmigs med gnyis kyi dang po ni/ a de la sems zin nas gzhan du mi 'phro ba dang*/ rtog med du lhan ne gnas pa ma byung gi bar du zhag gcig thun drug la sogs par byas nas skabs su khams bsang bya zhing bsgom mo// gsang sgron las/ dang po dben par lus bsdad nas// bya rgod mkha' la 'phur ba bzhin// dmigs gtad byas pa'i rig pa gtad// rlung sems gcig tu byas pa des// rtsol ba drag la thun du bya// dmigs pa dag la brten nas su// mi dmigs pa dag rab tu skye// zhes so// gnyis pa dmigs med la sems gtad thabs la/ gsum gyi dang po lus ngag gi gnad sngar ltar byas la/ yid kyi 'das ma 'ongs da ltar gyis bsam pa ci yang mi byed de/ sngar gyi dmigs pa gtad sa a'i mal der/ yid mig rlung gsum rtse gcig tu bsgrims la gtad cing logs su skad cig kyang yengs la ma shor bar byas la rtog pa ci byung tol skyes rbad chod du btang ngo*// gsang sgron las/ snga phyi rjes 'brang 'khrul pa'i lam// da lta'i shes pa ma bcos pa// mda' mkhan smyug ma srong ba bzhin// dmigs pa'i rtsol ba drag tu bsgrim// ces so// gnyis pa rtog pa ngos zin nas bcang mi thub pa zhig 'byung ba'i skabs su lus sems gnyis ka khong klod la/ sgom mi skye dogs pa'i blo mi byed nas/ rnam rtogs bzang ngan ci byung yang*/ sngon bsu rgyab skyel mi byed nas/ rang mal du klod la klod thog der bzhag ci nyan bya'o// 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis/ de la bzhag thabs bstan pa ni// lus ngag yid gsum mi bsdom par// sos dal khong klod bzhag pa yin// ces so// gsum pa 'gyu ba gnas pa gnyis so sor shes nas/ lus sems gnyis ka ha cang mi bsgrims mi klod/ ngan (328)mor bde tshod tsam du byas la/ rnam rtog bde mi bde ci byung yang bcas bcos mi byed par kho rang gang byung de nyid kyi steng du tsan ne bzhag cing 'tsho shes pa logs su yan mi gzhug pa gal che'o// gsang sgron las/

shes pa so ma gcig tu sdod// de bzhin gshegs pa'i dgongs pa yin// ces so// gsum pa skyon ngos bzung nas bsal ba la/ dam pa rin po ches gol sgrib sum bcur gsung pa'i nang nas/ ting nge 'dzin dang por mi skye zhing bar du mi 'phel ba'i skyon drug dang*/ bar chad bcu drug gsungs te/ de la skyon ni rnam pa drug /glo bur 'dod chags ldang ba dang*// zhe sdang chen po 'byung ba dang*// nga rgyal phrag dogs sems 'khrugs dang*// lta ba khengs dang de drug go /le lo bya ba mang ba dang*// sems g.yeng sems rgod de dang ni// sems sdug pa dang sems rjes 'brang*// sems rmugs pa dang rtog pa mang*// re ba mang dang dogs pa mang*// 'dod chags che dang brtson 'grus chung*// gnyid dga' kha ton klog 'dri dang*// bre mo'i gtam dang cal col smra// bar du gcod pa bcu drug te// mkhas pas 'di dag spang bar bya// zhes gsungs pas/ skyon de dag ngos zin nas dran shes bag yod dang ldan pas spang bar bya'o// de yang ting nge 'dzin skyon thams cad bying*/ rmugs/ rgod/ 'thor bzhir 'dus te/ bying ba ni shes pa hon nas ci byas ma tshor ba'o// rmugs pa ni shes pa mi gsal bar nag thibs se ba'o// rgod pa ni sems cung re gnas kyang bsam blo tsab tsub cung re dran pa'o// 'thor ba ni sgom brjed nas rnam rtog kha 'byams pa'o// de bsal ba la gnyis te/ sgom pa'i shugs las byung ba dang*/ rkyen gyis byung ba bsal ba'o// dang po ni/ sgom dus bying shing rmugs na/ mtho la bsil ba'i sar stan srab mo la bsdad nas lus sems hur btog (329)la shes pa seng nge ye re hrig ge cig byas la bsgom/ zas bcud can spang ngo*// rgod cing 'thor na dro zhing dma' ba dang nag pa'i sar stan 'bol ba la bsdad/ lus sems khong klod la lta stangs smad la bsgom mo// zas bcud can dang chang bzang po yod na nyung tsam btang ngo*// gnyis pa rkyen gyi 'byung ba ni/

sngar gyi gegs sam 'phral la chags sdang gi yul ngan gyis lhongs nas bying rgod byung na/ gsal sgron las// chags sdang gti mug dbang gis ni// rgod cing bying bar gyur pa'i tshe// phyi nang gsang ba gsum po la// sems gtod nas ni zhi bar 'gyur// zhes pas/ phyi ni 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa dang*// mya ngan 'das kyi yon tan bsam// nang ni shes pa rtse gcig bsdam// gsang ba lta ba dran par bya// zhes 'byung ngo*// skabs su bsgom 'tsher lus rmya zhing rtsub pa/ gnyid mi phebs pa byung na bsku mnye bya/ zas bcud can btang*/ spyod lam bag yangs bya'o// 'gro 'dod pa dang sems g.yeng ba dang mgo bstod na ba byung na/ lta stangs san smad/ 'og rlung bsdam/ rlung ro drag tu 'bud nas lus klod/ lus ljing sa la phabs nas shes pa lte bar gtad cing bsgom mo// nyams sgron las/ skyon dang bcos thabs la sogs kun// nyams dang khams kyi tshod bzung nas// skyon bcos sgrim klod zhal las shes// zhes pa'i don no// bzhi pa ting nge 'dzin gyi ngo bo la lnga ste/ nyams skye tshul gyi rim pa/ ting nge 'dzin rang gi ngo bo/ rgyun du btsa' thabs/ thun gyi tshad/ bogs 'don ba ste/ de dag re re la yang gsum gsum mo// skye tshul la g.yo thob brtan gsum ste/ g.yo ba'i nyams ni/ dang po bsgoms pas rnam rtog sngar bas mang ru song*/ sgom mi skye bar 'dug snyam pa 'byung*/ de ni rnam rtog ngos zin pa yin pas/ (330)gong du bstan pa ltar skyon dbang du ma song bar byas la/ rnam rtog kho rang gi steng du klod cing bzhag pas/ skabs su yod pa bsnyam pa dang*/ tu ma me re ba dang*/ lhan ne gnas pa snyam dang*/ ja sun 'thung ba tsam du rtog pa 'phro ba 'byung ngo*// nyams sgron las// de yang dang por chu drag bzhin// rnam rtog mang zhing cung zad gnas// zhes so// gnyis pa thob pa'i nyams ni/ thun gyi mgo rgab bar gsum du ma nges par// shes pa seng nge ba'am// bde lhan ne ba/

rtog pa med par mer re ba'am// lhem me ba'am// bde gsal mi rtog gsum char du skye ba'o// nyams sgron las// de nas dal drag chu bo bzhin// res 'ga' res rtog thun phyed gnas// zhes so// gsum pa bstan pa'i nyams ni/ thun re'am nyi dros pa'i bar tsam mam/ phyed skabs tsam du yang bying rmugs rgod 'thor med par bde gsal mi rtog gsum ka 'char ram/ shas gang che ma nges pa la gnas ba 'byung ste/ nyams sgron las/ de nas dal 'bab chu bo bzhin// shes pa ngal zhing thun du gnas// zhes so// gnyis pa ting nge 'dzin gyi ngo bo ngos bzung ba la gsum ste/ rab kyis mnyam gzhag tu bde gsal mi rtog pa gsum dus gcig tu skye ba de yang nyams phyi nang 'char ba/ sems nang du yod snyam pa lta bu ma yin par/ rang gi sems de nyid ngo bo nyid kyis bde ba/ rang bzhin gsal pa gnyis su med par thag chod pa'i ngang la/ shes pa rtse gcig tu gnas pa 'byung ba ni/ sngar thos bsam gyi blo dang mi 'dra bar/ don nyams su myong ba'i nges shes kyi dga' spro/ don gnyer mis don grub pa lta bu 'byung ngo*// sems rang bzhin 'od gsal ba'i mnyam gzhag tshe na 'byung ba ste/ nyams sgron las/ mnyam nyid yul bral ting (331)'dzin la// ma yengs ngang gis gnas par bya// skyes bu rab kyi spyod yul yin// zhes gsungs so// 'bring gsal dwangs su 'char zhing*// de nyid rang gi sems kyi rang bzhin du shes kyang rnam rtog dang 'od gsal so sor 'dzin pa 'byung ngo*// dam pas/ 'bring gis sems nyid 'od gsal la// yul dang shes pa'i tshul du mthong*// zhes so// tha ma ni lus bde sems dga' ba'i ngang nas shes pa mi 'phro bar lhan ne gnas pa 'byung ste/ dam pas// tha ma rtog pa'i bslad bral bar// mi g.yo tsam du gnas pa nyid// ces so// rjes thob tu ni/ rab dran pa zin dus sems rang snang yin pa dang*/ ma zin dus kyang tha mal gyi dngos 'dzin chung ba// 'bring dran pa zin dus sgyu ma lta bu rang bzhin med pa yin snyam pa dang*/

ma zin dus tha mal du 'gro/ tha ma dngos 'dzin rang ga ma'o// nyams sgron las/ rjes shes dran pa ma zin nas// tha mal 'chol ba btang snyoms gnas// dran zin tha mal a 'thas log /gzung 'dzin log par 'phrul pa shes// thug 'phrad shar dang rang log 'byung*// zhes so// gsum pa mnyam gzhag gi ting nge 'dzin de rgyun du rang gi rgyud la btsa' thabs gsum ni// dper na nor yod pa'i mis skyong bran dgos pa dang 'dra bas// rab kyis za nyal 'gro 'dug spyod lam rnam bzhi thams cad du lta bas snang srid thams cad sems su thag bcad cing*// sgom pas yul sems gnyis med rig pa rang gsal gyi nang la rgyun khyer bya'o// gsang sgron las// spyod lam rnam bzhi ci spyod kyang*// sems kyi rtsi yis zin pas na// 'di ni bzhag thabs dam pa ste// dgongs pa sangs rgyas thugs dang mnyam// ces so// 'bring gis mnyam gzhag dus kyi 'od gsal de/ da lta'i rang gi shes rig gi (332)ngo bo gsal stong 'di yin pa la 'gyur ba med par ngos bzung zhing*/ gang shar gyi steng du ma yengs par rig pa cog bzhag bya'o// ma yengs lam du khyer dgos pas/ nyams sgron las/ dper na rmu rgod rta 'dul ltar// ma yengs par ni bsgom par bya// zhes so// tha mal lus ngag yid gsum gyi g.yeng ba thams cad btsan thabs su bor zhing*/ yun ring thung che chung ci nus pas khong snyoms su mnyam par gzhag pa la brtson par bya'o// dam pas/ phyi nang g.yeng bas ma gos pa'i// gnas su yang yang bsgom par bya'o// zhes so// bzhi pa thun tshad la gsum ste/ khams bde zhing ting nge 'dzin gsal ba'i dus su thun ring bar bya/ khams nyog cing mi gsal ba'i dus su thun chung la grangs mang bar bya'o// nyin mtshan gyi gung gnyis dang mtshams gnyis bying rgod kyi dus yin pas srod tho rangs snga dro phyi dro bzhi la brtson nas bsgom goms nas spyod lam la khyer nus pa dang*/

thun la bcad du med par rgyun du ting nge 'dzin dang mi 'bral bar bya'o// nyams sgron las// thun tshad rab 'bring gsum du bcad// khams bde thun ni ring bar bya// mi bde thun bzhir bcad par bya// thun chen goms pa'i rnal 'byor bya// zhes so// lnga pa bogs dbyung ba la gsum ste/ rab rtogs pas bogs dbyung ba ni/ snang sems la bzang ngan dang bde sdug gi 'char tshul ci byung yang*/ blo ma bcos par gang shar de nyid kyi ngo bo la bltas pas/ mtshan 'dzin gyi rig pa nyid rang bzhin skye med/ rol pa 'gag med/ mtshan nyid dbyer med du grol bas/ snang ba dang rang rig dge ba'i bshes gnyen du 'gyur ro// 'bring gis spyod lam la lta sgom gyis rgyas gdab cing*/ skabs su rgyud lung zab mo'i lta ba dang*/ bskyed rim dang*/ thabs lam dang*/ 'khrul 'khor la sogs pas (333)bogs 'don te/ mdo rgyud dge ba'i bshes gnyen du 'gyur ro// tha mas 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsam zhing*/ bla ma la yang yang zhu gtugs// grogs po la gsal 'debs zhu ba dang*/ ting nge 'dzin la brtson 'grus kyis bogs 'don te/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten par bya'o// spyir rab 'bring tha ma gsum ka la yang*/ bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes bskyed la rgyun du gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ sems can thams cad la nye ring med par pha ma'i 'du shes kyis byams snying rje bsgom pa dang*/ nyams su blangs pa'i brtson 'grus yengs pa med pa dang*/ tshe 'di'i bde skyid snyan grags zas nor nye du'i zhen pa thams cad btsan thabs su bcad na myur tu yon tan chen po 'ong nges so// nyams sgron las/ lung zab bla ma nyams can spun// blta dang lta 'bul nyams bsdur dang*// mi rtag 'chi bsam brtson 'grus bskyed// gnas lugs dran pa'i rtsis zin pas// gsang spyod thabs la bsten pa dang*// rlung ngang bde ba'i man ngag dang*// dmigs med snying rje bsgom pa dang*// gdams pa'i gnad dang shes rab kyis// rig pa rtsal sbyang nyams sogs 'don// ces gsungs so// gnyis pa ting nge 'dzin skyes pa'i dpe ni/

dper na skyes bu 'jigs bcas zhig /lam la bgrod par gyur pa'i tshe// rang yul snang ba mthong slebs dang*// 'jigs pa'i rtogs pa med dang mtshungs// zhes pas lta sgom mthar phyin nas re dogs med pa'i dpe ni 'dir ma yin la/ nyams rtogs skyes pa'i gnas skabs su dbugs dbyung pa'i dpe ste/ rab snang sems dbyer med chos skur rtogs pas theg pa 'og ma'i rgyun rtsol ba la ltos pa'i 'jigs pa med/ 'bring rig pa rang gsal du gnas pa'i bying rmugs rgod 'thor gyi 'jigs pa (334)med/ tha ma lus sems dga' bde'i ngang la rtse gcig tu lhag par gnas bas dbugs phyin pa'o// gsum pa ting nge 'dzin skyes pa'i rtags bstan pa ni/ rtsa tshig las/ 'khor ba'i chos la skyo ba dang*// sems can rnams la snying rje skye// rang gi gnas la mi chags shing*// thag ring gzhan du 'gro bar 'dod// ces pas/ drod rtags phyi nang gsang gsum ste// gsang ba'i rtags ni/ nyams sgron las/ rlung gi mtshan ma lnga mthong nas// shugs snang brgyad sogs nyams snang dag /g.yo thob tsam du 'byung ba srid// ces pa ni/ sems dang rlung gnyis med brtan pa yin pas sems gnas pa'i tshe rlung zin cing*/ rlung la sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i rlung lnga ste/ de rtsa ro rkyang gnyis la/ lnga gnyis bcu nang du rgyu ba de nang du zin pa'i rtags su rnal 'byor pa'i mthong snang du/ du ba lta bu kha dog ma nges pa dang*/ smig sgyu lta bu chu'i rigs dang*/ srin bu me khyer dang*/ me stag lta bu me'i rigs dang*/ mar me 'bar ba lta bu gcig nas mang po'i bar dang*/ sprin med pa'i nam mkha' lta bu rgya che chung ma nges pa dang*/ dkar po dmar po ser po lam lam pa dang*/ snang ba med pa'i mun nag lta bu dang*/ nyi ma dang zla ba'i 'od can dang*/ 'od med dang*/ phyed po dang*/ bar snang sbrang 'dab lta bu skya tsig tsig pas gang ba dang*/ 'od kyi thig le kha dog lnga gang rung la/

'od zer gyi thag pa brkyang ba lta bu dang*/ 'od sna lnga ci rig pa mthong ste/ nyams sgron las/ rlung gi mtshan ma rnam lnga yang*// du ba lta bu'i long long la// smig sgyu lta bu'i gya gyu dang*// srin me lta bu'i dmar 'gro dang*// mar me lta bu'i dmar kan dang*// mkha' la nyi shar lta bur snang*// shugs snang brgyad po snang ba yang*// grur zhugs 'gro ba snyam byed dang*// snang ba mun par 'gyur ba dang*/ nam mkha' (335)rdul gyis gang ba dang*// mkha' la 'od du 'bar ba dang*// lus dang 'byung ba snang med par// sems nyid gsal stong dwangs pa dang*// me long skar mas brgyan pa mthong*// zhes so// gzhan yang sems ni 'khor 'das thams cad kyi kun gzhi yin pas/ thog med dus kyi shes bya'i bag chags thams cad kun gzhi la yod pa dang*/ kun gzhi des bskyed pa'i lus 'di la snang srid 'khor 'das kyi sa bon thams cad rtsa mdud la yi ge'i tshul du dod pa'i nang du rlung sems tshud pa'i rten 'brel gyis/ phyi snod nang bcud skye 'gro rigs drug /bem po dang rig pa can la sogs pa'i gzugs dbyibs kha dog sna tshogs pa zhes bya la ci srid pa gang yang snang du rung ba// rnal 'byor pa'i bsgom pa'i nyams snang yin pas bzang ngan gyi rnam pa gang la yang chags sdang mi bya bar nyams snang de nyid kyi steng du sems gtad cing snang sems bsre bar bya'o// nyams sgron las/ 'gro drug rgya gnas rlung tshug dang*// thog med bag chags sna tshogs dang*// sems nyid cir yang 'char ba'i phyir// 'gro drug snang tshul sna tshogs dang*// lha dang lha mo la sogs dang*// skyed mos tshal dang zhing khams sogs// ngan song gsum gnas sdug bsngal dang*// 'dod khams lha mi'i snang tshul dang*// gzugs khams gzugs med bsam gtan dang*// padma'i tshal dang sangs rgyas zhing*// nyams kyi snang ba cir yang 'char// de kun sems nyid rang snang la// mi g.yo de bzhin ma bcos bzhag

/ces so// nang gi drod rtags ni/ nyams sgron las/ drod ni bzod pa phra thob dang*// lus yang bde ba 'byung ba dang*// dbugs kyi rgyu ba mi tshor dang*// sems nyid rnal du phebs pa yi// gsal la yul med mi rtog gnas// zhes so// phyi rtags ni/ nor (336)rdzas gnyen 'dun la sogs pa// tshe 'di'i bya ba thams cad blos thongs nas// ci la yang chags zhen chung ba ste/ rtsa tshig ltar ro// gzhan yang*/ phyi rtags lus ni yod mi tshor// nang rtags dbugs ni rgyu mi tshor// gsang rtags dngos po'i zhen pa chung*// nyams ni ming du mi thogs shing*// shes pa khong nas dga' ba 'byung*/ lus ni 'dar zhing sprugs pa dang*// 'phag dang rgyug pa'i las rnams byed// ngag ni rgod cing ngu ba dang*// kha nas sgra skad sna tshogs 'byung*// sems ni 'dzin med btang dka' la// phyi nang shes pa mi rgyu ba// zhes pas/ rnal 'byor pa bsgom pa'i dus su lus la 'phra 'dar mchong rgyug tsha brad na sri sha 'gul sna tshogs dang*/ ngag tu rgod pa dang du ba dang*/ glu dbyangs la sogs skad sna tshogs dang*/ sems bde sdug gsal mi gsal mes tshig chus khyer khyi dang gcan sbrul la sogs gyis gtsos pa'i snang ba la sogs nyams la mi 'byung med pa med cing*/ lus ngag yid gsum la ci byung yang nyams yin pas bzang ba 'dra la dga' ba dang*/ ngan pa 'dra la mi dga' ba dang the tshom mi bya la/ nyams gang byung de nyid kyi steng du sems bskyed do// rmi lam gyi rtags mang du gsungs mod kyi/ rnal 'byor pa bden 'dzin 'phel ba'i rgyu yin pas nyams snang thams cad kyang bden med sgyu ma lta bur shes dgos na/ rmi lam la bden med du shes par bya'o// gsang sgron las/ gang la zhen pa med cing chags pa chung*// ma nor don la kun gzhi 'gyur med gsal// rtags chen de yod gzhan gyi khar ma lus// zhes gsungs pas/ tshe 'di'i bya ba la sogs snang ba mngon zhen chod na rtags gzhan ma byung yang bzod la rtags thams cad 'dzom yang mngon zhen che na du ba byung (337)ran me bsad pa dang 'dra'o// bzhi pa 'bras bu bstan pa ni/

rtsa tshig las/ rnal 'byor pa de 'gog pa'i tshe// nges par mi lus thob nas su// chos spyod pa dang ldan 'gyur te// de tshe chos nyid bden pa mthong*// zhes pa la gnyis te/ rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu ni/ rnal 'byor pa gnas pa'i nyams de tsam na tshe 'phos na gong du bstan pa ltar/ ting nge 'dzin rab la phyin pa de bar do'i 'od gsal ngos zin nas ting nge 'dzin rtsal rdzogs te/ sangs rgyas/ 'bring sgyu lus bar dor lha'i rig pa 'dzin par brdzus te skyes nas ting nge 'dzin rtsal rdzogs par 'gyur/ tha ma mi lus thob nas gdams ngag zab mo dang 'phrad nas chos nyid bden pa'i don mthong bar gsungs te/ nyams sgron las/ rang 'bras rnal 'byor 'pho ba'i tshe// gdams pa'i gnad dang shes rab kyis// 'gags med ye shes chos skur sbyor// 'gags med sgyu lus bar do nas// lha mi rig 'dzin de nas grol// phal cher bag chags rtog pa'i mthus// nges par mi lus thob nas su// chos spyod pa dang ldan gyur te// de tshe chos nyid bden pa mthong*// zhes so// skyes bu byed pa'i rnam smin gyi 'bras bu ni/ gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin des nyon mongs ba dang gzung 'dzin gyi mtshan ma che rags grol nas mi g.yo ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob par gsungs te/ nyams sgron las/ rtogs pa'i ngang gnas rnal 'byor pas// gsal la yul med goms pa yis// nyon mongs kun brtags 'bring bcom nas// brtan pa'i cha la mi g.yo thob// ces so// gnyis pa lhag mthong rtogs pa mi g.yo ba'i rnal 'byor la bzhi ste/ ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par gzhag pa'i thabs/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dpe/ de'i drod rtags dang*/ (338)'bras bu bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ rtsa tshig las/ ji srid mnyam par gzhag pa'i tshe// skyon gyi rnam pa bkag nas ni// rang byung ye shes drod dang ldan// nyin mtshan 'das kyi bar du gnas// zhes pas/ mnyam par gzhag thabs skyon ngos bzung nas ye shes sbyor thabs/

rtogs pa'i ye shes ngos bzung ba/ ting nge 'dzin la gnas pa'i yul dang bzhis ston te/ bzhag thabs ni/ gsang sgron las/ rnam shes 'du ba'i gnas dag tu// bag phebs lus sems klod par bya// rtog pa blo yi zhen pa bzlog /phra rags yul la blo mi bzung*// rang sems thabs kyis mthong byas te// yang dag shes rab mig gis blta// zhes pa de la yang gsum ste/ dang po phyi nang gsang ba'i rnam g.yengs med pa'i gnas su lus ngag yid gsum bde bar byas la tshogs drug gi yul la shes pa phyir mi 'phro bar rang gi sems la nang du yang dag par bltas te/ de yang da lta'i sems 'di 'gyu ba dang*/ gnas pa dang*/ gsal ba dang*/ bde ba ci ltar 'dugs brtag la/ gang du 'dug pa de la lta ba'i rgyas 'debs dang*/ 'di yin gyi blo bzo mi bya bar bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ngang la gnas 'dug na/ gang ltar 'dug pa de nyid la byung sa/ gnas sa/ 'gro sa/ ngo bo/ gzugs dbyings/ kha dog ci snang*/ sgom mkhan gyi sems dang nyams de la khyad par ci snang brtag cing kho rang gi steng du bzhag go /nyams sgron las/ ma skyes rang byung skye ba med// skye ba med pa'i chos nyid la// ma bcos rang byung lhug par bzhag /zhe 'dod mi bya phyal bar bzhag /ces gsungs so// de'i don chod na tshod tshul 'og nas 'byung*/ gnas pa yon tan du mi lta/ 'gyu ba skyon du mi lta bar rnam rtog 'gyu ba gang byung ngos bzung nas/ da lta dran bdo'i (339)rnam rtog de la byung gnas 'gro gsum/ ngo bo/ dbyibs/ kha dog ci byung ci snang*/ nyams bde gsal mi rtog pa dang*/ 'gyu ba de la khyad ci 'dug /rgyu rkyen gyi byas ma byas/ dri ma yod med khyad ci snang*/ sems kyi ngo bo de gang byung brtag /so sor phyes shing brtag /gcig tu bsre zhing brtag /'gyu gnas gang byung de nyid kyi steng du 'tsho zhing brtags te/ gsang sgron las/ zhi gnas bsgoms pas lhag mthong skye// rnam par rtog las ye shes skye// stong pa nyid la snying rje skye// zhes so// sems kyi don chod na/

gnyis pa ni/ sngar bshad pa'i drod rtags me/ du ba/ smig rgyu nas bzung ste/ sangs rgyas gyi zhing khams sku gzugs la sogs mthong snang bzang ngan ci byung yang de nyid la sems bsre zhing 'tsho/ nyams snang de la byung gnas 'gro gsum dngos po grub mtha' ci snang yang sems dang gcig gam tha dad brtag go /gsang sgron las/ zung du 'jug pa'i ye shes ni// rgyu dang rkyen la rag ma lus// thugs phrad shugs kyis lhug par 'char// ces so// 'di'i don chod na/ gsum pa ni/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya la sogs pa'i yul du snang ba thams cad/ nyon mongs pa dug lnga dang*/ bde sdug gi tshor ba dang*/ 'khor 'das la re dogs la sogs sems la byung tshad kyi steng du bzhag cing*/ ngo bo dbyibs kha dog byung gnas 'gro gsum sems dang sems byung khyad ci snang brtag go /nyams sgron las/ chos sku spros bral rang rig gsal// sku gsum rang chas rtsol med las// byar med skyes bu ci bzhin du// lus sems khong klod gang dgar bzhag /ces so// de ltar sems la gang shar gyi nyams bskyang dgos pa yang*/ bang mdzod las/ 'dod chags (340)zhe sdang gti mug kyang*// rnam rtog rlung gis mi bskyod na// de nyid rang byung ye shes yin// rang byung ye shes chen po yang*// rnam rtog rlung gis bskyod pa na// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug yin// zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa skyon ngos bzung nas ye shes sbyar ba la/ dam pas/ mi mthun phyogs kyi skyon bstan pa// gol sgrib sum cu so drug ste// nor du dogs pa lnga bshad na// chad par dogs dang rtag par dogs// phyal bar dogs dang bying bar dogs/ med par dogs dang de lnga'o// sgrib pa chen po bcu bshad na// mi g.yo gsal dang bde sdug bsngal// sems la shes 'byung mngon shes dang*// mtshan ma'i rdzu 'phrul 'byin pa dang*// 'di la bla med mchog 'dzin dang*// bdag gi lta ba snyems pa dang*// gzhan gyi lta ba khyad du gsod// 'di dag sgrib pa chen po'o// mngon shes mtshan mar 'dzin pa bdud// mi bzad dug 'thung 'dra ste skyon// zhes gsungs pas/

lta sgom la thun mong pa'i dri ma lngas gting du mi phyin cing*/ yon tan la mngon par rlom pa bcus gong du mi 'phel ba ste/ de ltar bco lnga'o// rnal 'byor dang por bshad pa'i skyon drug /bar du gcod pa bcu drug dang sum bcu rtsa bdun du 'gyur yang*/ skyon drug sgrib bcus lta ba snyems gnyis gcig tu brtsi bas gol sgrib so drug po de dag gis rnal 'byor dang po'i ting nge 'dzin mi skye mi 'phel bas spang ba yin la/ 'dir snang srid sems su rtogs shing sems nyid chos skur rtogs pa'i tshe/ gol sgrib kyi skyon drug /sgrib pa bcu/ dogs pa lnga/ bar chad bcu drug /bying rmugs rgod 'thor gang byung yang de nyid kyi steng du bzhag cing ngo bo la bltas pas/ gol sgrib thams cad rig pa'i rtsal ma 'gag pa las cir yang snang zhing*/ rig pa nyid gzhi med rtsa bral (341)du skyon yon gyi mtha' las 'das par rtogs pas skyon thams cad ye shes su 'char ba'o// skyob pas/ thams cad bdag tu rtogs pas nyon mongs skyo yul med// bdag nyid bsam mi khyab pas nyon mongs skye mkhan med// nyon mongs ma bcad rang tshod sangs rgyas dgongs pa yin// zhes pa dang*/ dam pa nyid kyis skyen skyon sel gsungs pa/ stong pa lta med chad ma song*// ther zug lta med rtag ma song*// bsam rjes ma 'brangs phyal ma song*// rmugs pa med na bying ma song*// rang rig shes rab gsal yod pas// med par ma song de dag go /zhes so// gsum pa rtog pa'i ye shes ngos bzung ba la bzhi ste// rtogs pa skye tshul gyi rim pa dang*/ rtogs pa rang gi ngo bo/ de rang gi rgyud la btsa' thabs/ gong du bogs 'don pa'o// dang po ni/ sems la 'char sgo gang byung gi steng du bzhag cing*/ de'i ngo bo la bltas pas mnyam par gzhag thabs gsum las/ rnam rtog skye tshul gsum 'byung ste/ dang po rnam par rtog pa phra rags gang byung thams cad rang byung rang zhi gsal stong du grol nas/

gsal stong de nyid rang rig pa'i ye shes su rtogs pa ni/ rtogs pa'i ye shes mgo g.yo ba zhes so// mnyam gzhag rtog pa rang grol dang*// gsal stong bde la mi rtog gnas// zhes so// de nas ngar 'dzin rnam par rtog pa gra ma chags zur ma nyams pa de nyid rgyun chad med cing 'dus ma byas pa'i rang byung gi ye shes dri med chos skur lhag gis rtogs pa ni rtogs pa'i ngo bo thob pa zhes bya'o// klong gsal las/ rang byung ye shes rang las byung*// de shes ye shes tsam du brjod// ces so// kun byed las/ rang byung rgyu rkyen med par 'byung ba yin// ye shes 'gag pa med par gsal ba yin// zhes (342)so// de nas nyams snang gang byung ba thams cad rgyun chad med par 'gag med rig pa rang snang du rtogs la/ gzhan snang srid shes bya'i chos thams cad sems nyid rang snang du rtogs shing snang sems gnyis med du 'dres nas yul med rang gsal gyi ngang du gnas pa ni/ rtogs pa brtan por zhugs pa na// yul med rang gsal nyams kyi gting*// zhes so// chod tshul gsum po de la/ sems nyid 'od gsal chen po la// ji srid mnyam par gzhag pa'i tshe// rnam par rtog pa sngon la 'byung*// ye shes chen po phyi na shar// skyon bcos g.yo ba'i nyams zhes bya// gsal ba'i ngang la rtog pa 'byung*// 'byung ba de nyid dbyings su rig /skyon bcos thob pa'i nyams zhes bya// snang gsal dran rig ye shes klong*// cir snang 'gag med 'dzin chags med// gnyis med rig pa lhun gyis grub// rtag tu de ltar gnas pa ni// skyon bcos brtan pa'i nyams zhes bya// zhes gsungs pas mngon no// gnyis pa rtogs pa rang gi ngo bo la rab 'bring tha gsum ste/ rab kyi mnyam gzhag dus su sems nyid skye ba med pa gsal stong ka dag chos kyi sku las ma g.yos bzhin rgya mtsho la gzugs brnyan 'char ba ltar/ 'gag pa med pa'i rol pa las shes bya thams cad ma 'dres yongs rdzogs lhun gyis grub pa la ma skyes mi 'gag snga phyi med par mtshan nyid dbyer med du nyams su myong zhing*/

myong mkhan gyi rig pa nyid gtan tshig gsum gyi ngo bor rang grol pa ni sku gsum dbyer med kyi dgongs pa zhes bya'o// skyong ba las/ ma bcos spros bral chos kyi sku// ma 'gag rang byung longs spyod rdzogs// mtshan nyid sna tshogs sprul pa'i sku// sems dang chos skur 'dres pa ni// sku gsum ngo bo dbye ba med// ces so// rjes thob ni/ dran (343)pas zin tshad kyi snang ba thams cad sems nyid rang snang sgyu mar 'char zhing*/ ma zin dus btang snyoms su gnas te tha mal gyi 'khrul snang med do// nyams sgron las/ dran zin gnyis med gsal 'dabs shing*// rang snang sgyu mar gsal ba dang*// rtsol med btang snyoms chen por gnas// zhes so// 'bring gi mnyam gzhag tu snang rig gi chos thams cad yul med rang rig pa rang gsal rang snang du gcig pa'i ngang du gnas pas re dogs gnyis 'dzin la sogs pa'i lta sgom gyi skyon mi mnga' ste/ nyams sgron las/ mnyam gzhag mi mthun gnyen po bral// ma gtad yengs med mi g.yor gnas// bde gsal mi rtog spros dang bral// zhes so// rjes thob ni/ dran pa zin dus rig pa rang snang du shes shing*/ ma zin dus tha mal du 'gro yang 'phral du zin no// nyams sgron las/ rjes shes dran pas ma zin na// tha mal 'chor dang btang snyoms dang*// skabs su rang log thug 'phrad 'byung*// zhes so// tha ma ni/ mnyam gzhag tu rnam par rtog pa nyid rang byung gi ye shes su rtogs shing*/ rig pa rang gsal gyi ngang la gnas pas 'gyu gnas gnyis la khyad par med cing*/ bang mdzod las/ rig pa phyi nang med par gsal bas lhag mthong yin// gsal ba'i don la ma yengs zhi gnas yin// zhes so// rjes thob ni/ dran pas zin dus tha mal gyi zhen pa med pa btang snyoms su 'dug la// ma zin dus tha mal 'khrul snang du 'char// nyams sgron las/ tha mal 'chor dang btang snyoms gnas// zhes so// gsum pa/

nyams rtogs zung du 'brel ba de rang gi rgyud la sbyor zhing btsa' thabs ni/ byang chub sems rdzogs pa chen po'i don sems kyi rang bzhin rtogs pa'i don (344)la ting nge 'dzin dang ldan na/ de'i btsa' thabs la rnam pa drug ste/ phyi nang gi dam tshig nyams na g.yeng ba byung nas bsgom mi khom pa dang*/ 'jug dka' ba dang*// sems gnas mi thub pa dang*/ lus sdod mi tshugs pa byung na lta ba kha 'byams su 'gro/ ting nge 'dzin gyi drod rtags thams cad rjes yal du 'gro ba'i mthar ngan song kha brgyud nas 'gro bas/ dam tshig thams cad ma nyams pa bsrung ba gal che ste/ lung las/ de la dam tshig phyi dang nang*// rang bzhin phung po khams bzhi gnas// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ sgom pa'i dus bsam dpyod drag po mang na chu rnyogs pa dang 'dra ste/ yun du bsgoms kyang ting nge 'dzin gyi rnyogs ma mi dwangs pas sems kyi rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings la ma yengs bag gis blta bar bya'o// lung las/ snang ba med pa'i chos nyid ni// ma btsal bzhag na sgom pa yin// de dang de ni rnam btsal na// de la de bzhin mi snang ngo*// gsum pa ni/ ting nge 'dzin shin tu gsal yang yun ring na sngar goms shas chung ba'i dbang gis bying rgod byung yang ngos ma zin te/ ngos bzung bral ba'i rig pa rgyas 'debs su song nas bden pa mthong du mi gtub/ nges shes dang brtson 'grus chung ngu 'gro bas/ ting nge 'dzin ma dub tsam du bzhag nas khams gso bar byas la bsgom mo// bzhi pa ni/ rnal 'byor pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi shugs dang lta ba'i rlabs mthong ba'i dbang gis snang srid ye shes su 'char zhing mthong sgom gyi drod rtags ltar du 'char ba'i dus na nyams dang rtogs pa'i nga rgyal skyes nas/ da ni bdag la ting nge 'dzin gyi 'gal rkyen med snyam ste/ 'jig rten gyi khe drag dang*/ 'du 'dzi dang*/ 'dod yon dang*/ bkur sti dang*/ nye 'khor gyi rjes su 'brangs nas/

chos brgyad kyi mgo yang ma 'jil bar bdag cag rnal (345)'byor pa yin zer zhing sangs rgyas par gdon mi za bar skad pa de ni shin tu 'khrul te/ 'byung ba'i lhag ma ma zad pas lus la zhen cing*/ 'du shes kyi lhag ma ma zad pas chags sdang 'byung ba yin te/ slar yang de'i bag chags kun gzhi la bsags nas mtho ris kyang mi thob na thar pa lta smos ci dgos/ des na rtag tu dgon pa bsten cing 'jig rten gyi 'brel ba bcad de chos brgyad kyi khur po spang bar bya'o// lnga pa rnal 'byor pa la mngon shes sam yon tan phra mo byung nas de la rang yang rlom pa skye zhing gzhan la yang sgrogs pa de ni/ bdud kyi las bar chad thams cad 'jug pa'i rgyu yin pas/ mngon shes rdzu 'phrul yon tan ci yod kyang doms pa dang*/ dom po mi bya la sbed cing*/ yon tan gong 'phel la brtson par bya'o// drug pa ni/ gdams ngag dang po thebs nas sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du gdams ngag gi 'debs lugs/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dmigs khrid/ dbyings kyi snang lugs/ ye shes kyi 'jug lugs/ nyams rtogs kyi mtshan ma thams cad snying sgor yang dbyung bar mi bsam na khar dbyung ba lta smos kyang ci dgos/ gal te smras na las dang po pa'i nyams dang drod rtags gtan nas med par 'gyur zhing*/ gding thob nas kyang sangs rgyas myur tu mi thob par byed do// lung las kyang*/ rgya mtsho'i mjing gi pha bong bzhin// bskal pa 'khrugs kyang khar mi dbyung*// zhes so// thog ma nas tha ma'i bar du bla ma ni rtag tu yid kyi ting nge 'dzin du bya zhing*/ yud tsam yang 'bral ba'am/ 'phya ba'am/ ngan sems sam/ mi dgos par mi blta'o// gal te skyon de dag byung na bsam gtan je med du 'gro nas ngan song gsum du kha brgyud par byed do// zhes gsungs pas/ de la dang por gnas zhing*/ (346)zag med mngon du ma gyur gyi bar du dran shes bag yod dang ldan pas brtson par bya'o// bzhi pa nyams rtogs thogs 'don pa la gsum ste/

rab yon tan gyis ngoms nas 'di bas yon tan gong na med snyam nas/ rlom pa dang khengs pas bcings te bogs mi thon pa yin te/ rang la skyon de lta bu ci 'dra 'dug yang yang ngos bzung zhing*/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las ma lus pa rang sems la tshang nas yod pa mngon du ma gyur cing*/ sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa'i dgongs pa yon tan thams cad sangs rgyas dang mnyam par yod kyang rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par 'jug pa dang shes sgrib kyi bag la nyal sbyang dgos pa la/ rang la da lta zag bcas kyi nyams ban bun skabs re yod kyang rkyen dang 'phrad dus tha mal rang du shor ba 'di la nga rgyal nas ting nge 'dzin la mi brtson pa bdud dbang du song nges snyam pa byas la/ nga rgyal dang rlom pa byed mkhan/ nyams su myong mkhan/ rtog mkhan de tshur sems la rtsad bcad cing*/ rtog mkhan gzhi med rtsa bral du yang yang du grol pa gal che'o// nyams sgron las/ rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs ston mdzad cing*// 'jig rten grags pa sgrogs pa dang*// longs spyod g.yeng bas brid pa dang*// drod rtags byin rlabs stobs skyes nas// dga' brod rlom sems nga rgyal na// bdag med thar pa'i bar du gcod// de kun sems nyid rang snang las// ma g.yos gnyis med ngang du gzhom// ces so// 'bring mnyam rjes thun mtshams song nas mnyam gzhag dus snang sems phyogs re la 'dres kyang gdal khyab tu ma song zhing rjes thob lta sgom dang ma 'dres na bogs mi thon pas mnyam rjes thams cad du shes pa hur bton/ snang ba rgya bskyed/ rig pa ngar bskyed nas spyod lam thams cad du lta sgom gyis (347)zin par byas la gtsang btsog dang bde sdug thams cad blang dor med par tshogs drug ro snyoms rig pa'i rtsal sbyang bar bya'o// dgongs pa skyed chung 'thas pa na// rtogs pa'i ngang nas ma yengs pas// gsang spyod spyod pa sna tshogs bya// rjes shes dran pa'i thag pa yis// rta rgod bzhin du bsgrims la btsa'// de ltar lta spyod spel ma yis// mi g.yo rgyun goms brtan par bya// zhes so// tha ma ni nyams rtogs cha re la chags nas bogs mi thon pas/

rig ngor byung tshad kyi shes bya yul snang dang*/ shes bya yul la 'jug tshad kyi shes byed kyi rig pa 'char tshad la phar bzhag tshur len mi byed nas gang shar de nyid kyi steng du mnyam par bzhag cing*/ snang sems gnyis gcig gam tha dad byung*/ gcig na yul sems so sor snang zhing dus gcig la yang gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya du mar snang ba ci yin/ tha dad byung na gang zag gcig la'ang nyams snang nyin snang mtshan rmi lam snang ba dang gnas skabs gsum du brjod kyis mi long par snang ba de/ gcig yod pa'i dus gnyis po de gang du snang brtag cing*/ snang ba rnam gsum la phyir grub pa ci snang*/ 'das pa'i snang ba thams cad gang du snang*/ ma 'ongs gar yod/ da lta'i snang ba la dngos po ci 'dug /snang ba'i rig pa nang du grub pa ci 'dug /'das pa gar song*/ ma 'ongs pa gang du yod// da lta ba'i rig pa de gang du gnas/ gzhan yang 'khrul grol lam gsum gang zag gcig gi sems rgyud la 'char ba de ji ltar byung*/ da lta yang bde sdug thams cad so sor ma 'dres par myong ba de ci yin/ legs par brtag shing dpyad pas/ snang ba rnam gsum ji ltar snang yang*/ sems 'gag med kyi rol par rang snang zhing sems nyid gzhi (348)med rtse bral gdod nas ka dag chen po rtogs pa'i bogs dbyung ngo*// dam pas lhun grub mngon du ma gyur bar// gol sgrib gdar sha gcod pa gces// zhes bsam gtan spyi 'grel du sems kyi gdar sha gcod pa'i thabs mang du gsungs pa'i don yin no// bzhi pa ting nge 'dzin mthar phyin pa'i tshad dang yun ni/ rtogs pa rab 'bring tha ma gang rung gi ngang la/ rab nyin mtshan 'khor ba re tsam/ 'bring nyin re tsam/ tha ma thun re tsam du bar mi chod pa ste/ nyams sgron las/ rang byung ye shes drod dang ldan// rgya mtsho'i gting ltar mi g.yo la// nyin phyed nyin dang nyin zhag nas// zhes so// gnyis pa ting nge 'dzin de'i de'i dpe ni/

rtsa tshig las/ mi rtog mi dmigs thig le bde// mi bskyod dwangs pa'i rgya mtsho ltar// mi g.yo gsal ba'i mar me 'dra// de ni ye shes bde pa'i drod/ ༈ /ces pa'i dpe bzhi ste/ dang po ni/ thig le gcig la grwa zur med pa'i zlum po gcig tu yod pa ltar 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad ci ltar yang yul du mi rtog ste/ sems nyid rang byung gi ye shes rang snang zhing sems thig le nyag gcig la bde sdug gnyis su mi dmigs pa'i ngang du gnas pa ngo bo nyid kyi bde ba'o// klong chen las/ thig le gcig la gra zur med// gdal ba chen po chos kyi sku// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ dpe rgya mtsho chen po rlung gis ma bskyod pa la gzugs brnyan thams cad ma 'dres la gsal ba ltar/ sems kyi ngo bo 'od gsal ba la mtshan ma'i rtog pas ma bskyod pa la/ snang srid ma 'dres yongs rdzogs su rang snang ba'i ngang la gnas pa'o// dper na rgya mtsho dwangs pa la// skar tshogs gzugs brnyan mang snang yang*// nyid las mi gzhan sa ler snang*// de bzhin snang bas chos rnams kun// chos dbyings dwangs pa'i dkyil 'khor na// ma 'dres yongs su rdzogs par gsal// zhes gsungs so// gsum pa ni/ mar me phyi nang med par gsal ba ltar// chos (349)thams cad yul med rig pa rang gsal gyi ngang la gnas pa'o// lta med rig pa rang gsal ni// yul med spros bral ji bzhin nyid// rang snang rig pa'i 'khor lo la// yul med rang gsal rig pas mthong*// zhes so// bzhi pa ni/ des don gsum po de gnas pa'i nyams rab 'bring tha gsum dang mi g.yo'i nyams rab 'bring tha gsum 'dres par gyur pa'i zhi gnas dang lhag mthong zung du 'jug pa ni/ dper na me dang drod mtshungs par ldan pa bzhin/ rtogs pa'i ye shes nyams myong dang mtshungs par ldan pa'o// gsum pa drod rtags bstan pa ni/ rtsa tshig las// zas dang gos kyi 'du shes chung*// nyon mongs la sogs chags sdang chung*// snying rje phan sems rab tu che// rmi lam rtags bzang rab tu byung*// zhes pas/

phyi nang gsang ba gsum ste/ gsang ba'i drod rtags ni gong du dpe bzhis bstan ba'i nyams rtogs mtshungs ldan de nyid do// nang gi drod rtags ni/ lus mngon zhen chod pas na che drag po la sogs pa'i bde sdug ro snyoms pa dang*/ lus yang zhing bde bar gnas pa dang*/ sems las su rung ba'i ting nge 'dzin la rgyun du gnas pa'i// nyams sgron las/ drod ni shing bal ltar yang dang*// lus kyis bzod pa cher thob dang*// khams snyoms rang lus bde ba rgyas// 'gyu ba can dang the tshom bral// gsal ba yul la mi g.yor gnas// zhes so// phyi rtags chos thams cad sems nyid rang snang du rtogs pas// gzung 'dzin rang sar grol te/ chags sdang gzhi med du med du grol nas rang gi zas gos kyi zhen pa dang*/ gzhan la phyogs ris kyi rtsod 'then dang*/ khe grags don du gnyer ba'i chos brgyad kyi bya ba rang rgyud la mi 'byung zhing*/ sems can la phyogs ris med pa'i snying rje dang phan sems 'byung ngo*// nyams sgron las/ ting 'dzin rlung (350)zin drod ldan pas// zas dang gos kyi 'du shes chung*// nyon mongs ngar 'dzin phyogs cha dang*// chos brgyad chags sdang kun brtag sogs// shin tu chung zhing phra rab gnas// 'khrul pa ya mtshan thugs brtse ba'i// tshad med thugs rje chen po 'byung*// zhes so// rmi lam du yang sgren mor phyung nas khrus byed pa la sogs sgrib pa dag pa'i rtags dang*/ mun khung dang 'dam rdzab nas thon pa la sogs ngan song nas thar pa'i ltas dang*/ rang las 'od byung nas snang srid gsal ba la sogs bden pa mthong ba'i ltas dang*/ yi dam lha'i zhal mthong gsung thos la sogs 'byung bar bshad kyang de la dga' zhing bden par 'dzin na bdud du 'gro bar gsungs pas rang snang sgyu mar shes par bya'o// gsang sgron las/ thams cad sems su shes pa bdud kyi glags mi rnyed// ces so// gzhan yang zag med mngon gyur ni ma thob/

rtsa khams nyams snang bzang po yod pa'i rnal 'byor pa la/ nyin dang rmi lam du nyams sna tshogs 'byung ba la bzang ngan du zhen cing bden par 'dzin na bdud kyi dbang du 'gro zhing*/ gang la yang chags sdang med par rang snang dngos med du shes na lam rtags yin te/ dam pas/ rtags ni gnyis su shes par bya ste/ phyi rtags bdud kyi mtshan ma bco brgyad de/ sangs rgyas byang sems mthong ba dang*/ 'khor du bdag gis chos nyan pa dang*/ rang nyid 'phags pa'i gzugs su snang nas 'khor la chos bshad pa dang*/ skad cig ma la bskal pa grangs med 'gyed nus pa dang*/ rgyud sde thams cad chags thogs med par 'chad nus pa dang*/ rigs drug gi sems can mthong ba dang*/ de dag gi tshe dang las bzang ngan shes pa dang*/ de la snying rje'i sems skye zhing don bya bar 'dod pa dang*/ rang gi lus la 'od chen po nyin mtshan med par 'byung ba dang*/ ri dang rtsig pa la mi thogs pa dang*/ nam mkha' la 'khur ba dang*/ phyogs (351)bcu'i sangs rgyas kyis phyag spyi bor 'jog nas dbang bskur ba dang*/ lung ston pa dang*/ phyogs gar 'dod du thogs chags med par 'gro nus pa dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi skad du chos ston nus pa dang*/ lha klu mthu bo che rnams kyis bdag bkur zhing bka' sgrub pa dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi skad go bar 'byung ste/ de la mtshan mar bzung na bdud kyi las yin te/ ci'i phyir na/ mtshan mar 'dzin pa la bdud kyis skabs tshol la/ mi 'dzin pa la skabs mi rnyed do// nang yon tan gyi rtags chen po brgyad de/ sangs rgyas dang mnyam par gtam yang rlom pa med pa dang*/ 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa skad cig la mthong yang ngom pa med pa dang*/ bdud kyi rgyal po 'ong yang 'jigs skrag med pa dang*// lha yi bu mo mthong yang chags sems med pa dang*/ chos nyid bsam du med pa'i ngang la gnas kyang chos spyod bcu'i bar mi chad pa dang*/ spyod lam thams cad du ting nge 'dzin dang mi 'bral ba dang*/

'dod yon lnga la spyod kyang zhen chags med pa dang*/ sdug bsngal gyi rkyen byung yang ting nge 'dzin gyi grogs su 'gro ba'o// zhes gsungs par ltar shes par bya'o// bzhi pa 'bras bu ni/ rtsa tshig las/ de lta bu yi rnal 'byor pa// 'byung ba lnga po zhig pa'i tshe// lha yi rig 'dzin chen po thob// de tshe de la sangs rgyas so// zhes pa la gnyis te/ rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu ni/ rab gong du bstan pa ltar mi g.yo ba'i nyams rtogs pa ma bral bar de mthar phyin nas rnal 'byor pa tshe 'phos na/ bar do'i 'od gsal gyis bsu/ da lta'i 'od gsal gyis skyes/ 'chi kha'i 'od gsal gyis mtshams sbyar nas 'od gsal ma bu 'dres te skad cig ma la 'tshang rgya'o// nyams rtogs 'bring gi tshad ni/ phung po len par byed pa'i rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa rang grol te/ (352)skye ba mi len par lha'i rig 'dzin/ ces pa/ lha ni gnyis 'dzin bral ba'i rig pa rnam par dag pa yin la/ 'dzin pa mi gtong ba ste/ gnyis 'dzin bral ba'i rig pa dri med de nyid ting nge 'dzin du shar nas stobs rdzogs te/ sangs rgyas zhes chos rje gtsang pas 'bru brnan to// tha ma ni/ zhi gnas kyi sems cung zhig las su rung bas 'dod khams su ma skyes la/ gzugs khams dang gzugs med kyi khams gang rung gi rten la mnyam pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin mthar phyin te/ sangs rgyas sar sems so// nyams sgron las/ mi g.yo ngang la rnal 'byor pas// 'byung ba lnga po zhig pa dang*// rab ni ye shes chos skur sbyor// 'bring ni ye shes bar du gnas// stong gsal sems la dbang thob cing*// lha yi rig 'dzin chen po thob// de tshe nyid la mngon sangs rgya// zhes so// skyes bu byed pa'i rnam smin gyi 'bras bu ni/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin yin te// nyams sgron las/ mi g.yo dang gnas rnal 'byor pa'i// thugs rjes spyod pa sna tshogs dang*// mi rtog thig la'i klong gnas pa'i// dgongs pa nyon mongs kun brtags sgrib/

phra ba bcom nas mnyam nyid thob// ces so// gsum pa mnyam pa nyid kyi rnal 'byor la bzhi ste/ rang gi ngo bo// dpe/ drod rtags/ 'bras bu bstan pa'o// dang po ngo bo ni/ rtsa tshig las/ 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos// ji lta bur yang mi gzigs te// thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gsal// lo zla 'das kyang de bzhin gnas// zhes gsungs so// gong gi rnal 'byor gnyis po'i zhi lhag nyams rtogs gcig tu 'dres na mthar phyin pa'i 'bras bu yin pas/ 'khor 'das snang srid snod bcud bzang ngan/ rtag chad/ yod med/ bde sdug /re dogs/ yin min la sogs pa gnyis 'dzin gyi mtshan ma thams cad rang grol te/ (353)yul phar snang gi rtog pa med par/ rig pa rang byung gi ye shes nyid chos thams cad du lhun gyis grub cing*/ yul nyid rig pa'i ngo bor ka dag pa ste/ snang sems gnyis med kyi mnyam gzhag chen po mngon du gyur pa'o// 'khor ba mya ngan 'das pa'i chos// ma skyes rang snang dmigs med phyir// yul med rang grol cir mi gzigs// thams cad mnyam pa nyid du gsal// zhes so// de ltar mnyam gzhag tu chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid mngon du gyur pa'i ngo bo la// rab 'bring tha ma'i dbye ba med cing*/ bzhag thabs/ skye tshul/ btsa' thabs/ bogs 'don rnams la 'og ma lta bu yul yul can/ mtshan ma'i brtags dpyad dang nyams len gyi rim pa med kyang*/ da rung sgom pa'i lam yin pas rjes thob mnyam gzhag la khyer dgos pa la/ mnyam rjes 'dres ma 'dres kyi rim pa yod de/ mnyam nyid ngang la mnyam rjes thob// cung mnga' tshul bzung rtsod pa can// ces gsungs pas mnyam gzhag gis ma zin pa'i spyod lam ci 'byung ngos bzung nas/ rang rig gi 'char sgo/ gnyis 'dzin gyi rtog pa gang byung kho rang gi steng du mnyam par gzhag ste/ gsang sgron las/ ting 'dzin rab tu gyur pa na// ma bcos so ma lhug par bzhag /ces so// nyin par mnyam rjes med kyang gnyid ma gnyid kyi mtshams su bag chags kyi snang ba ban bun 'byung ba dang*/

gnyid dus su rmi lam gyis mnyam gzhag bar chod ma chod kyi tshad bzung zhing ma yengs pa'i ngang la khyer/ nyin mtshan dang mnyam rjes kyi dbye ba med par rgyun chags nas kyang mnyam par gzhag mkhan dang*/ sgom pa'i brtson pa byed mkhan/ rtog cing nyams su myong mkhan kho rang gi steng du bzhag dgos te/ re zhig yin tshul shes pas mi phan no// gsang sgron las/ gdags su med pa'i chos nyid la// mtshan mar btags pa blo yin pas/ (354)chos nyid blo las 'das pa yin// blo yi blo gros ngo mtshar che// 'di ni blo gros dam pa'i rgyud// ces so// skye tshul gsum ni/ zag med kyi rtogs pa dang por skyes pa/ bar du mnyam rjes bsre ba/ tha ma 'dres pa gsum la g.yo thob brtan gsum du phye'o// btsa' thabs bogs 'don ni/ gong gi khyer thabs de bas logs su med do// skyon sel ni 'dir mi dgos te/ nyams sgron las/ khyad par nyams rtogs cir snang yang*// nyon mongs rtsad chod mnyam nyid phyir// brtags pa'i bye brag 'di la med// ces so// ting nge 'dzin mthar phyin pa'i tshad ni lo zla grangs kyis bgrangs kyang mnyam gzhag la rkyen cis kyang mi chod/ brgyal zhing ra ro ba dang 'du shes thams pa mi 'byung*/ 'byung bzhis bsdus pa'i lus la 'pho 'gyur byung yang na tsha la sogs pa'i rkyen nyid mnyam gzhag gi ting nge 'dzin du 'char bar gsungs so// gsang sgron las/ skyes bu goms pas gar rgyug lhung med ltar// skye med rtogs shing 'dris pa'i rnal 'byor pas// gang ltar spyad kyang mnyam pa nyid kyi ngang*/ zhes so// gnyis pa dpe bstan pa ni/ rtsa tshig las/ mnyam nyid mi g.yo chos sku'i ngang*// bzung bas mi zin chu zla 'dra// rtog med mnyam pa de nyid ni// khyud chen nam mkhar lding dang mtshungs// zhes pas/ dgongs pa rang gi ngo bo dang*/ rtsol ba med par sangs rgyas kyi sa la phyin pa'i dpe gnyis ston te/

rang gi ngo bo ni dper na chu dwangs pa'i nang du zla ba'i gzugs brnyan snang yang chu nyid las ma g.yos pa ltar/ mnyam nyid kyi dgongs pa la chos thams cad ye shes rang snang du lhun gyis grub pa'o/ gnyis pa ni/ dper na nam mkha' lding la bya bran lta bu'i rtsol ba dang*/ ngam grog lta bu'i g.yang sa la dogs pa dang*/ 'gro sar mi phyin dogs pa'i 'du shes med par yud tsam gyis gar 'dod phyin pa ltar/ mnyam nyid rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ (355)rnal 'byor 'og ma lta bu'i rtsol ba dang*/ 'og mar ltung gis dogs pa dang*// 'tshang mi rgya dogs pa'i 'du shes med par rtsol med kyi ngang nas sangs rgyas kyi sa la gshegs pa'o// gsum pa drod rtags bstan pa ni/ rtsa tshig las/ yo byad 'du shes thams cad 'gog /dge dang mi dge rnam rtog med// nyon mongs sgrib pa rnam par dag /nyams kyi rmi ltas sna tshogs 'byung*// zhes pas/ phyi nang gsang ba gsum las/ gsang ba'i drod rtags ni/ nyon mongs dang khams dang skye gnas kyi zag pa gsum dang bral ba// dge sdig gnyis kyi 'bras bu bde sdug gnyis la re dogs gnyis med/ skye rga na 'chi'i chu bo bzhi brgal/ bdud bzhi bcom nas zag med mnyam nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin rgyun chad med par rang ngo shin tu rnam par dag go /nyams sgron las/ mnyam nyid kun bral kun dngos phyir// zag med zas gos zhen pa grol// kun brtags nyon mongs chags sdang dang*// ngar 'dzin phyogs cha re dogs dang*// chos brgyad la sogs rtsad nas chod// 'jigs pa lnga bral bdud bzhi bcom// 'du 'bral med pa'i dgongs pa la// dus phyed btang snyoms chen por gnas// zhes so// nang rtags ni/ mngon bar shes pa spyan lnga dang drug ste/ ma bsgribs rang gsal mnyam nyid kyi// zag med shes rab spyan mnga' bas// mngon par shes pa rnam pa drug /gsal dang rgyun gyis khyad par 'phags// zhes so// phyi rtags ni/

gzhan snang gi rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs pas 'gro ba 'dul ba ste/ mnyam nyid ngang las ma g.yos bzhin// zhing khams stong gsum brgya stong phrag /thugs rjes rang byung sprul pa yi// rngon dang smad 'tshong shan pa dang*// lha mi'i bsod nams ldan la sogs// gang la gang ltar 'dul ba bzhin// mngon shes rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs dang*// (356)sprul pa'i lus kyis 'dul bar byed// rang byung cho 'phrul bzhir snang ba// nyi zla zhon nas mkha' la 'gro// ri brag la sogs thogs med dang*// chu la mi byings mes mi tshig /dug dang mtshon dang nad mi tshugs// chu rgyun bzlog dang rlung mi 'gul// sreg pa'i bskal pa gzhil la sogs// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'bum 'byed dang*// skam par chu phyung bye ma gser// sol bar ljon shing dug la sman// mi snang ba dang mngon par sprul// ri rab bkyag nas gsor ba dang*// 'jig rten rgyang mar 'phen pa dang*// stong gsum yungs 'bru shong ba dang*// yungs 'brus stong gsum khengs pa dang*// gzhan yang ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin// tshe dang dus la bsring bstung dang*// 'gugs dang gtad dang 'ching dang dgrol// gso gsang pham rgyal thogs med 'grub// rang byung thugs rjes byin gyis brlab// 'gro ba rigs drug mu stegs dang*// lam dang sa la gnas ba dag /so so'i skad dang cha mthun pas// gang la gang 'tshams chos ston nas// rnal 'byor ting 'dzin rtsal stobs kyis// 'jig rten brgya stong g.yos nas kyang*// ngo mtshar cher skyed dga' zhing mgu// nang g.yos pa yang rim g.yo byed// gsang ba sngags kyi sgra bsgrags pas// kun kyang rmad byung sngags kyi sgrar// grags pas bdud 'dul ngan song spyod// theg chen lam 'dzud 'gro don mdzad// ces so// bzhi pa 'bras bu ni/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ngo bo la// lam dang sa yi rig 'dzin thob// de yang bgrod du med pa ste// de tshe nyid la sangs rgyas thob// ces pa la/

lam dang sa'i rig 'dzin zag med kyi rtogs pa mngon gyur mthong lam yin cing*/ sgom lam la gsang sngags nang pas lam gyi rig 'dzin bzhi dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pas 'phags pa'i sa bcur bzhed pa gang yang mnyam gzhag tu chos nyid mngon (357)sum du rtogs pa de'i rgyun goms par byed nas/ rjes thob tu shes sgrib phra rags mnga' ba de sbyang ba'i rim pa yin pa ltar/ 'dir yang zag med mnyam pa nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ngang la goms par byed cing*/ rjes phra rags mnyam gzhag la bskyal ba yin pas/ rang gi ngo bo lam gyi rig 'dzin bzhi dang 'phags pa'i sa bcu'i thad yin gsungs/ 'og ma'i sa lam gyi rig 'dzin dang*/ 'phags pa rnams bskal pa'i grangs dang mi tshe'i dus la ltos nas shes sgrib rim gyis sbyong ba dang mi 'dra ste/ 'dir shes sgrib gnyis can gzung 'dzin gyi chos thams cad gnyis med rang byung gi ye shes su rtogs shing*/ de'i ngang la rgyun goms par byed cing*/ rjes shes mnyam gzhag la bskyal ba kho na yin la// 'di la rab 'bring gnyis te/ rab mnyam rjes med pa ni/ rgyu mthun dang skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras bu nyid tshe lhun gyis grub pa'i ting nge 'dzin thob nas/ rang ngo la skye 'chi med pa rdo rje'i sku brnyes nas rnam smin gyi 'bras bu sangs rgyas pa'o// 'bring mnyam gzhag tu zag med kyi ting nge 'dzin yod kyang rjes thob tu mtshan ma'i rtog pa yod pa tsam la tshe 'phos pa ni/ 'chi ka'i gnad gcod la sogs pa'i rkyen gyis byas te/ ting nge 'dzin cung zhig brjed song yang phyi dbugs song nas nang dbugs ma song gi bar ram tha ma yang lus sems bral ma thag tu rgyu mthun nam/ skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras bu/ rjes su dran pa drug 'byung ste/ skabs 'dir bar do yin par dran pa/ der bla ma dam pa dran pa/ des bstan pa'i gdams ngag dran pa/ sngar gyi nyams len rtogs pa dran pa/

de ma thag tu chos nyid ma bu 'bres pa'i skad cig ma de la gzung 'dzin rang grol ka dag chen por sangs rgyas pa dang*/ spyan lnga mngon shes drug la sogs pa'i yon tan ma lus rdzogs (358)pa ni rnam smin gyi 'bras bu'o// nyams sgron las/ mnyam nyid ngang gnas dgongs spyod dang*// dgongs pa'i ngang gnas shes rab kyis// shes sgrib rags dang 'bring bcom nas// btsal ba med par lhun 'grub thob// ces pa dang*// mnyam pa nyid kyi ngo bo la// zag pa kun bral rin chen 'dzin// skye 'chi 'pho 'gyur med pa'i phyir// de tshe nyid la mngon sangs rgyas// zhes pa'i lung gnyis po 'di rab 'bring gnyis ka'i lung thun mong ma yin no// bzhi pa ye shes lhun grub lam mthar phyin pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ rtsa tshig las/ rang gi ngo bo chos kyi sku// dpe ni dpe med nam mkha' 'dra// rtags ni sangs rgyas cho 'phrul 'byung*// 'bras bu sangs rgyas de nyid do// zhes pas/ ngo bo dang*/ dpe dang*/ rtags dang*/ 'bras bu bzhi'o// dang po ngo bo la gnyis te/ rnam pa ni/ sku lnga lhun grub sangs rgyas kyi rgyal tshab chen por bzhugs pa ste/ lhun grub rig 'dzin ces pa'i don no// nyams sgron las/ rang byung lhun grub chos kyi sku// rang gi rgyal tshab ston par byed// ces so// dgongs pa ni rang snang lhun grub chos kyi sku ste/ skye med rang byung mngon byas pa'i// rtsol med bde chen lhun grub la// mtha' dbus skye 'gag rnam dag dbyings// sku lnga ma 'dres kun tu bzang*// zhes so// gnyis pa dpe ni chos can mtshan ma'i dpes mtshon mi nus te/ chos nyid lhun grub kyi nam mkha' ni mthar lam chen po de nyid dang*/ sangs rgyas ma gtogs pa gzhan gang gis kyang shes par mi nus pa'o// phyogs re'i cha nas dgos 'dod 'byung*/ ci bsam 'grub/ ye shes gsal/ ma rig sel ba'i dpe du ma ste/ de nyid las/

nam mkha'i dpe ltar mtshon du med/ cha tsam dpag bsam rin chen shing*// me long nyi ma'i snying bo 'dra/ (359)zhes gsungs so// gsum pa rtags phyi nang gsang gsum ni/ sangs rgyas dang mtshungs te/ gsang rtags sgrib gnyis bral ba'i ye shes rgyas// nang rtags zag med kyi mngon shes dang*/ rdzu 'phrul yon tan mtha' yas pa la dbang 'byor/ phyi'i rtags sku'i rdzu 'phrul/ gsung gi chos brjod/ thugs rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul sna tshogs mdzad pas nam mkhas khyab tshad kyi sems can thams cad kyi don mdzad pa'o// nyams sgron las/ rtags ni sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul dang*// yon tan sna tshogs rang bzhin rdzogs// ma bsgribs kun gsal mngon shes drug /rgyu rkyen me long tshul gzigs pa'o// yul dang mkhyen tshad rgyal ba dang*// 'dra la bag la nyal bas phye// zhes so// bzhi pa 'bras bu ni/ sangs rgyas dang dgongs pa yon tan thams cad 'dra yang bag la nyal yod med kyi khyad yod de/ 'di 'bras bu dngos ma yin mthar lam yin pa'i don gyis bag la nyal zhes bya ba'i phra ba gnyen po ye shes dang mi 'bral ba dang*/ gong du bsnyen bkur ba'i gnas sangs rgyas dang*/ mar don bya ba'i gnas sems can du snang cha nam mkha'i 'ja' lta bur mtshan ma'i sgrib g.yogs med kyang rang snang tsam gcig mnga' ba de/ gzhan rkyen la mi ltos par rang rig pa'i ye shes chen pos skad cig ma la rtogs pa grol ba dus mnyam ste sangs rgyas pas/ g.yo thob brtan gsum du phye'o// nyams sgron las/ lhun grub chen po'i dgongs spyod dang*// mtha' bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas// dmigs med rang rig shes rab kyis// skad cig nyid la tha ma yi/ bag la nyal bcom de bzhin gshegs// zhes so// don gsum pa rjes su 'bras bu thob tshul ni/ rnal 'byor pas gong du bstan pa ltar sngon 'gro rnams kyis rgyud snod du rung bar byas nas/ dngos (360)gzhi rnal 'byor bzhi la g.yo thob brtan gsum du phyes pas/

rim pa dang po gzhi gnas lam brten na/ thos bsam gyi go ba bzang po yod kyang sems las su mi rung bas/ 'gal rkyen spang ba la sogs rnal 'byor dang por bstan pa'i rim pa ltar nyams su blangs pas sems las su rung pa'i zhi gnas khyad par can snyen la/ de yang rang rig rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi ma khyab na 'jig rten pa'i bsam gtan du gol bas/ rnal 'byor gnyis par ci ltar bstan pa'i rim pa so sor dpyod pa'i shes rab kyis snang srid chos skur rtogs par byed cing*/ de yang zag med mngon du ma gyur na zag bcas kyi nyams rtogs thams cad mi rtag cing 'gyur bas/ rnal 'byor gsum par ci ltar bstan pa bzhin// yeng med kyi ngang las mnyam gzhag chen por goms pa mthar bskyal te/ rnal 'byor bzhi pa'i bag la nyal gyi sgrib pa rang grol nas gzhi sems nyid rang byung gi ye shes la rang snang la sku lnga lhun gyis grub pa mngon du byas te/ rang bzhin skye ba med pa chos kyi sku// rol pa 'gags pa med pa sprul pa'i sku// mtshan nyid dbyer med longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku// thams cad rig pa rang byung gi ye shes las ma g.yos pa ngo bo nyid kyi sku/ 'khrul grol lam gsum du 'pho 'gyur med pa rdo rje'i sku/ sku lnga yongs rdzogs dpal kun tu bzang po mngon du gyur pa'o// nyams sgron las/ kun sangs kun dngos rdzogs sangs rgyas// rang byung ye shes mngon byas pas// spang thob gnyis med de bzhin nyid// sku dang gsung thugs yon tan las// bsam gyis mi khyab ma 'dres rdzogs// 'bras bu'i klong du shes par gyis// nyams rtogs sna tshogs snang ba dang*// mthar phyin yon tan kun rdzogs kyang*// chos dbyings 'phel 'grib med pa'i phyir// gzhi las g.yos pa rdul tsam med// ces so// de ltar sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi rjes gsum (361)gyis rdzogs pa chen po nyams su blang ba'i yi ge 'di ni/

rtsa chog nyams rim bzhi pa dang*/ de'i rgya bskyor dga' rab rdo rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i nyams sgron dang*/ rtsa tshig gi rab byed 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad par bzhed pa dang*/ dam pa bde gshegs pa'i yig chung nyams kyi man ngag gol sgrib sum bcu rtsa drug /btsa' thabs drug pa/ bsam gtan spyi 'grel/ chos rje gtsang pas mdzad pa'i don gsal/ rtogs ldan shākya rdor ba'i theg pa spyi'i nang du rim skyes pa'i nyams len bzhi'i skabs rnams kyi tshig don gang mkho skabs su ma nor blangs shing*/ nyams len gyi rim pa dngos gzhi snyan brgyud thor bur yod pa rnams legs par bsgrigs te/ man ngag gi rgyud gzhan nas kyang lung gis kha bskangs shing rang gis nyams su myong tshul la brten nas/ nges pa'i don la blo gcig tu gzhol ba'i sprang po nam mkha' rdo rjes phyi rabs kyi gang zag gdams ngag nyams su len pa rnams la phan pa'i blos/ chu mo bya lo zla ba lnga pa'i yar tshes la bla ma dam pa'i bzhugs gnas dpal gnam steng ri khrod du sbyar ba 'dis/ sems can thams cad bde blag tu rang grol nas/ sku lnga lhun gyis grub pa dpal kun tu bzang po mngon du byed par gyur cig /maṅga lam/// /(362)
